+from docx import Document
+from docx.oxml.table import CT_Row
+from docx.oxml.parser import OxmlElement
+
+def test_grid_span_lookup():
+    """Test that tc_at_grid_offset correctly handles cells with grid spans"""
+    doc = Document()
+    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
+    row = table.rows[0]._tr
+    
+    # Make first cell span 2 columns
+    first_cell = row.tc_lst[0]
+    tcPr = first_cell.get_or_add_tcPr()
+    gridSpan = OxmlElement('w:gridSpan')
+    gridSpan.val = 2
+    tcPr._insert_gridSpan(gridSpan)
+    
+    # Access grid position 0 (should return first cell)
+    cell0 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(0)
+    assert cell0 == first_cell
+    print("✓ Grid position 0 correctly returns first cell")
+    
+    # Access grid position 1 (should also return first cell since it spans positions 0-1)
+    cell1 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(1)
+    assert cell1 == first_cell
+    print("✓ Grid position 1 correctly returns first cell (with grid_span=2)")
+    
+    # Access grid position 2 (should return second cell)
+    cell2 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(2)
+    assert cell2 == row.tc_lst[1]  # The original third cell is now the second cell after merging
+    print("✓ Grid position 2 correctly returns second cell")
+
+def test_grid_before_lookup():
+    """Test that tc_at_grid_offset correctly handles rows with grid_before offset"""
+    doc = Document()
+    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3)
+    row = table.rows[0]._tr
+    
+    # Set grid_before to 2 (first two grid positions are empty)
+    trPr = row.get_or_add_trPr()
+    gridBefore = OxmlElement('w:gridBefore')
+    gridBefore.val = 2
+    trPr._insert_gridBefore(gridBefore)
+    
+    # Access grid position 0 (should fail - before first cell)
+    try:
+        row.tc_at_grid_offset(0)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        print("✓ Grid position 0 correctly raises ValueError (before first cell)")
+    
+    # Access grid position 1 (should fail - before first cell)
+    try:
+        row.tc_at_grid_offset(1)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        print("✓ Grid position 1 correctly raises ValueError (before first cell)")
+    
+    # Access grid position 2 (should return first cell)
+    cell2 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(2)
+    assert cell2 == row.tc_lst[0]
+    print("✓ Grid position 2 correctly returns first cell")
+    
+    # Access grid position 3 (should return second cell)
+    cell3 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(3)
+    assert cell3 == row.tc_lst[1]
+    print("✓ Grid position 3 correctly returns second cell")
+    
+    # Access grid position 4 (should return third cell)
+    cell4 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(4)
+    assert cell4 == row.tc_lst[2]
+    print("✓ Grid position 4 correctly returns third cell")
+
+def test_combined_grid_before_and_span():
+    """Test combination of grid_before and grid_span"""
+    doc = Document()
+    table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
+    row = table.rows[0]._tr
+    
+    # Set grid_before to 1
+    trPr = row.get_or_add_trPr()
+    gridBefore = OxmlElement('w:gridBefore')
+    gridBefore.val = 1
+    trPr._insert_gridBefore(gridBefore)
+    
+    # Make first cell span 2 columns
+    first_cell = row.tc_lst[0]
+    tcPr = first_cell.get_or_add_tcPr()
+    gridSpan = OxmlElement('w:gridSpan')
+    gridSpan.val = 2
+    tcPr._insert_gridSpan(gridSpan)
+    
+    # Access grid position 0 (should fail - before first cell)
+    try:
+        row.tc_at_grid_offset(0)
+        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
+    except ValueError:
+        print("✓ Combined test: Grid position 0 correctly raises ValueError")
+    
+    # Access grid position 1 (should return first cell - it starts at position 1 and spans 2 positions)
+    cell1 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(1)
+    assert cell1 == first_cell
+    print("✓ Combined test: Grid position 1 correctly returns first cell")
+    
+    # Access grid position 2 (should also return first cell - it spans positions 1-2)
+    cell2 = row.tc_at_grid_offset(2)
+    assert cell2 == first_cell
+    print("✓ Combined test: Grid position 2 correctly returns first cell (spanning)")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_grid_span_lookup()
+    test_grid_before_lookup()
+    test_combined_grid_before_and_span()
+    print("\n✅ All tests passed! The fix correctly handles grid spans and grid_before offsets.")
